title: Eyrndor: RP Core
description: Added a command for role-playing in Minecraft.
body:
![Banner Roleplay Core](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc38d0f67f48daf3eb9deed1c3fad8173681c152.png) --- ## Roleplay Core Roleplay Core is a Neoforge 1.21.1 mod that allows Minecraft server administrators to add roleplay-specific commands. For now, the mod adds the essential features needed for roleplay.
FEATURES (Click to expand) - Roll: Players can **/roll** to perform actions. (Visible from 25 blocks away). - Actions: The Minecraft **/me** command has been updated to display the RP name instead of the username. (Visible from 25 blocks away). - Roleplay Name: The **/setname** command allows players to set their RP name. - GM Actions: MJ can use the commande /rp [range] to diffuse roleplay actions.
> This mod is currently under development so some features will be available soon.
UPCOMING FEATURES (Click to expand)
--- ![Sun1lnx banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac238321d88183abd9a4ee17f4a4e1380e3b712e.png) ## CREDITS Hey, I'm a French computer science student who has been passionate about Minecraft since 2017. Since 2020, I've been developing scripts and plugins for Minecraft servers. As part of my Eryndor role-playing network project, I've started working on mod. - [GitHub](https://github.com/sunl1nx) - [Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/sunl1nx_) - [Eryndor Discord](https://discord.gg/56XCPQQpbW)
